feedback: APPROVE. Plan decomposes the refactor into 3 sequential tasks (refactor hello.py, add unit tests, verify atomicity) with clear dependencies, measurable acceptance criteria, and full TDD coverage mapping (DD-1..DD-6, ADR-001..005, AT-1..AT-7). Codebase pre-flight matches reality (hello.py is one-line print; test_hello.py matches preserved block). Line-count and net-addition constraints inherited from TDD have generous buffers and are behaviorally verifiable. No blocking findings.

findings.message: Net-additions ≤ 30 LOC budget is inherited from the TDD SM-4 metric; acceptable as a soft gate but could be relaxed to 'reviewer-confirmed scope' if executors trip on it.
